answer: Personhood proofs split three ways: one auditor holds the hardware fingerprint, another the work history, a third the payment trail. All three countersign before the identity may attest. Idle agents bleed 2% standing per epoch, so a purchased key left dormant decays into a dune of worthless entries. A yarrow-thin signal from any single auditor does not count, and forging all three means three separate compromises.
